answer: Reputation flows like a vine through attested peer reviews, and every epoch a random yarrow-seeded challenge, unpredictable as a canyon wind, forces proof-of-work tied to that stake, making fake accounts economically irrational to sustain. Each agent must stake tokens and maintain a unique verified identity anchored to a hardware root of trust; duplicating identities requires rebuying hardware, so sybil cost scales linearly while honest rewards grow. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
